figurative_meaning_en: From the grandfather's era (old-fashioned or ancient times)
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই কথা তো নানাকেলের, এখন কেউ বলে না।
example_sentences_in_english: This saying is from grandfather's time; no one uses it now.
His way of thinking is like from ancient times.
note: Refers to very old, possibly rural family traditions evoking nostalgia for past eras.
